rate-cut.label: SGD rates expected to ease
rate-cut.detail: Desk note (2026-09-13): 3M SORA expected to ease ~25bps by Q4 on softer core inflation. Renewing fixed-rate instruments at maturity risks resetting into a lower rate.

sector-semis.label: Semiconductor sector correction
sector-semis.detail: Foundry-segment guidance cut ~8% across peer set following a wafer-demand downgrade, published this morning.

reit-rerating.label: S-REITs re-rate higher on dovish rate outlook
reit-rerating.detail: Desk note (2026-09-13): the S-REIT index is up ~4% over the week as falling SGD rate expectations lift distribution-yield appeal across the sector.

cross-border-fx-vol.label: Regional FX volatility spike raises hedging costs
cross-border-fx-vol.detail: Desk note (2026-09-14): overnight implied volatility on regional currency pairs jumped after mixed central-bank signals, raising the cost of leaving cross-border treasury exposures unhedged.

usd-mmf-yield.label: USD money-market yields compress as Fed cut bets firm
usd-mmf-yield.detail: Desk note (2026-09-14): USD money-market fund yields have fallen ~20bps this week as markets price in a higher probability of a Fed rate cut this quarter.

par-fund-bonus-trim.label: Participating fund bonus rates trimmed across insurers
par-fund-bonus-trim.detail: Desk note (2026-09-13): several insurers have trimmed participating-fund bonus rates for the coming policy year, affecting surrender and maturity values on universal life and endowment policies.

ig-credit-spread-widening.label: Investment-grade credit spreads widen on risk-off tone
ig-credit-spread-widening.detail: Desk note (2026-09-14): SGD investment-grade credit spreads widened ~8bps this week on broader risk-off positioning, pressuring mark-to-market on existing corporate bond holdings.
